name: Iron Gauntlet
description: The warrior who wore this fought until the gauntlet's straps outlasted the arm inside them. Someone cut it free rather than carry the rest.

name: Worn Wooden Shield
description: Every scar on it came from a blow meant for someone standing behind the one holding it.

name: Charm of Life
description: Carved by someone who was not good at carving, for someone who would wear it anyway. The knife slipped twice on the same curve.

name: Small Mana Gem
description: 'Guard it with your life,' a spellcaster told their apprentice. It was found afterward in a closed fist, and the fist was not easy to open.

name: Sharp Claw
description: The grip on this handle is sized for a hand much smaller than the claw's original owner ever had. One person pulled it, another mounted it, and a third swung it.

name: Stone of Endurance
description: The runes came later, cut into a stone already carried for years as a lucky weight. They run around a thumb-worn hollow instead of across it.

name: Ring of Focus
description: A mage traded away 3 better rings before settling on this plain one, saying the others made them feel too clever to stay careful.

name: Warrior's Necklace
description: Every fang on this came from the same fight. The one who strung them together was the only one left standing by the end of it, and tied the cord short enough that the fangs sit against the throat.

name: Pendant of Calm
description: 'I won't need calm where I'm headed,' they said, handing it back before they left. The cord was still knotted to fit their neck.

name: Traveler's Ration
description: There is always 1 more portion in here than the party needs. The extra one is wrapped in a different cloth, tied with a different knot.

name: Ancient Sword
description: Someone spent their last good days trying to translate the engraving, convinced it named whoever had betrayed them. Their notes stop partway through a letter.

name: Heart of Stone
description: 'I carved it after my own heart,' they said, and did not say which day. The carving is deep and even everywhere except at the center, where the hand lifted.

name: Eternal Vial
description: Its last owner drank from it exactly once a day, no more, certain that any more would use up whatever kept it full. They were still counting when it changed hands.

name: Arcane Core
description: 3 books of notes try to transcribe what the humming says. All 3 end on the same word, spelled 3 different ways.

name: Thorned Armor
description: Built for someone who wanted no one close enough to strike them, or to hold them. The only blood on the thorns is on the inside of the left arm.

name: Venomous Dagger (Relic)
description: This changed hands exactly once, from the one who poisoned the blade to the one it was used on. The wrap on the hilt was never replaced.

name: Vampiric Fang
description: 'It only took what the thing didn't need anymore,' insisted whoever pulled this free. It leaves a faint warmth in the hand that does not come from the hand.

name: Featherweight Boots
description: These were made for leaving a room without anyone noticing. The heels are worn on the outer edge, from turning in doorways.

name: Quickcharge Rune
description: Carved in the dark, in a hurry, before there was time to be sure it would work. The last stroke runs off the edge of the stone.

name: Spiked Cloak
description: A new spike was added for every close call its first owner walked away from. It's short exactly 1 spike of what would have been a matching set on both shoulders.

name: Serpent Ring
description: Carved as a warning to any thief who might try to lift it. The fangs are worn bright on the inside of the band, where the wearer's finger sat.

name: Thunder Totem
description: Carved during a storm that lasted longer than anyone down here remembers a storm lasting. It started crackling, by every account, before the last line was even cut.

name: Armor of Wholeness
description: Made for someone who never got the chance to wear it into anything worth calling a battle. The lining has no sweat in it, and the buckles have never been moved off the first hole.

name: Bloodthirsty Blade
description: 'I only meant to make it sharp,' the smith swore. The grip has been rewrapped 4 times, each wrap over the last.

name: Phantom Step
description: These were enchanted by someone who wanted to be somewhere else the instant before they actually were. The soles are worn through at the toe and nowhere else.

name: Scholar's Insight
description: The last third of this notebook is written in a hand trying to match the first two-thirds. The loops are slower, and some letters were gone over twice.

name: Crown of Destruction
description: The tyrant who wore this made sure people would learn the name. It was engraved inside the band, and the band has been filed smooth.

name: Immortal Heart
description: More than once, someone asked for this to be finished properly. The knife marks on it are shallow, and every one of them stops short.

name: Reaper's Covenant
description: The first one to take this up did not read everything scratched along its edge. Everyone who carried it since left the same lines unread.

name: Eternal Scholar's Tome
description: The early margins hold questions. The later ones hold only corrections, in a smaller hand, and the last few correct the corrections.

name: Blackened Locket
description: It used to hold a portrait. The portrait was burned before whoever was in it could become something worse, and the locket was worn for years afterward, still closed.

name: Shackle of Hunger
description: Forged to hold something back, never meant to be worn. Someone closed it on their own wrist first, and the inside is worn bright where they pulled against it.

name: Unstable Core
description: Carried in both hands, wrapped in wool, held away from the body. The wool on one side is scorched brown where it rested against the glass.

name: Heavy Guilt
description: Wear this long enough and the shoulders start curving in. Its last owner slept in it, and the straps left two grooves in the skin.

name: Worn Wedding Band
description: 'A promise I intend to keep,' they used to say about it. The inside is worn thin on one side, from being turned with the thumb.

name: Child's Whittled Horse
description: Whittled by hands too unsteady for the job, for someone who would not have minded the wobble. It was never delivered. One leg is short, and it stands.

name: Bundle of Undelivered Letters
description: Addressed to someone who was never told to expect them, tied with string by someone who kept meaning to send just 1 more before finally handing over the whole stack. The ink on the top letter has blurred where a thumb rested on it, reading it over.

name: Half a Chalice
description: Two people broke this in half on purpose, each taking the piece they thought proved they were right. Neither of them made it back down here to settle it.

name: Torn Ritual Page
description: Torn free by the hand that wrote it. The writing stays careful to the last line, then runs off the edge in one long stroke.

name: Snapped Ritual Blade
description: Forged for a single, specific cut that was never explained to the one meant to swing it. It snapped on the first and only attempt, cleanly, where the blade was thinnest.

name: Guardian's Unburnt Ember
description: Pulled from something that had stopped moving but had not finished burning. It was still warm on the climb up, and has been cold in every hand since.

name: Guardian's Scale
description: Pried loose from something nobody who was there could agree on the shape of, afterward. It's warm on 1 side no matter how it's turned, and hasn't matched a single thing anyone's fought since.

name: Cracked Spiral Stone
description: Scratched into stone with something that wasn't a chisel, long before anyone down here started using one. This wasn't a copy of anything. Every spiral cut since has been copying this, several hands removed, and none of them know it.

name: Fused Twin Coins
description: 2 coins from 2 different people, melted together by something neither of them chose. One face stays closed in on itself; the other's worn open. The seam between them has been scratched at with a knife point, never deep.

name: Waystone Shard
description: A shard of something never carved, only grown that way, smooth on every edge but the break. Someone wrapped the break in cloth before carrying it up.

name: Vigil Cloth
description: Folded the way you fold something you mean to come back for. It was folded the same way every night, and the last fold was never opened.

name: Torn Lock-Plate
description: The other half of what was stamped into the seal, torn away with whatever was behind it. Read together, the two halves would complete the spiral. The torn edge is still bright.

name: Worn Chalk Stub
description: Worn down to a nub on a line that should have taken half as much chalk. The last stroke wavers, then starts again lower down.

name: Cracked Scrying Glass
description: Dropped once by an apprentice, and the crack runs edge to edge. Spells came easier afterward, they said, and the glass stayed in its frame, cracked.

name: Knotted Red Thread
description: 9 knots, and only the last one has never frayed. Whoever tied it was tying against something particular, and never said what.

name: Resonant Tuning Fork
description: Struck once, mid-incantation, it rang for the length of a full watch. The spell being cast at the time went off a good deal harder than intended.

name: Runner's Ankle Cord
description: Frayed white at both ends from being tied fast and untied faster. The knot in it is a runner's knot, made to come loose with one pull.

name: Bitter Root Charm
description: Chewed flat at one end by someone who kept it in their mouth until the bitterness stopped registering, and the sickness with it.

name: Hunter's Tally Stick
description: 39 notches, each cut only once the thing was confirmed dead. The 40th is half-started and has never been finished.

name: Censer of Ash
description: Nobody has ever emptied the ash inside, and it's still warm. Casters who've held it say the words come out heavier, as though they'd been written somewhere first.

name: Signal Whistle
description: Blown from a standstill it gives nothing but breath. Blown mid-run it carries three floors down, and everything below turns to look.

name: Threshold Salt Pouch
description: Enough salt to line every doorway on a floor, and the pouch is still full. Whoever poured the first line stopped at the last door and did not pour that one.

name: Stormglass Orb
description: The weather inside the glass never matches the weather outside. The caster who kept it learned to glance at it before speaking; the thumb smudge is from that.

name: Unbroken Seal
description: Pressed 3 times over the same letter, by 3 different hands, the wax has never been broken. Everyone who carried it said it got easier once they stopped wondering what was inside.
